newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, Lagardere, submit Thomson-CSF bids.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Lagardere, submit Thomson-CSF bids.

text.p: French electronic engineering group Alcatel Alsthom and missiles-to-publishing conglomerate Lagardere said on Wednesday they had submitted firm and final offers for Thomson-CSF.
Alcatel said it made a joint bid with Dassault Industries for the defence electronics group and hoped that aerospace group Aerospatiale would join if it was the winner.
Lagardere said it would issue a special five billion franc bond convertible into Thomson-CSF shares to help fund the deal, along with its own cash and credit lines.
In London, Britain's GEC said it had signed a memorandum of understanding with both candidates bidding for Thomson-CSF.
It said it would enter talks to combine some of the businesses of its GEC-Marconi division with those of Thomson-CSF.

The French government had ruled out a full bid by the British company, citing national security interests, but had said it would welcome it linking up with one of the main French bidders after the sale.
The government is selling its 58 percent stake in Thomson-CSF, after abandoning last year an attempt to sell parent company Thomson SA, which also owns consumer electronics group Thomson Multimedia.
